title: No backend. No key. One command.
tagline: Public reference data, straight from the CLI.

steps.comment: # look up Douglas Adams — no install, no backend, no API key
steps.command: npx skeem get items Q42 --adapter wikidata --json
steps.note: One Q-id, and identifiers for IMDb, MusicBrainz, Open Library, VIAF… all ride along — every value is an array.

steps.comment: # go the other way: which item owns this IMDb id?
steps.command: npx skeem find items --where imdb=tt0133093 --adapter wikidata --json
steps.note: Reverse lookup by external id — the bridge runs both directions.
